method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

pathways.compact_statement: Sughd–Batken disputes and repair backlash constrain irrigation governance under variable water availability.
alternative_explanations: Infrastructure degradation, water losses, agricultural demand and contested jurisdiction are important independently of climate trends.
pathways.uncertainty: Source-stated institutional mechanism, not isolated climate causation or an audit of current 2026 border conditions.
recommendations: Keep the reverse mechanism bounded to the named institution, population and place supported by its cited evidence; do not infer violence from climate vulnerability.
